This [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''warrior''' was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] during the latter years of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he was the second largest member of a group of Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] that pursued [[Hohass Ekwesh]] and [[Estoric Sandskimmer]], members of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], as they escaped from a [[Shaper caste|shapers']] compound on the planet with a [[Mission to Chashima|stolen]] [[commbuzzer]], a bioweapon that the Yuuzhan Vong planned to use against the Galactic Alliance. The warriors threw [[Nang hul|thud bugs]] at the fleeing Wraiths, striking Sandskimmer and causing him to fall to the ground and drop the bioweapon, allowing the warriors to catch up to them. As Ekwesh stood his ground with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] to protect his injured companion, the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong leader (Chashima)|leader]] of the warriors ordered the second largest warrior and the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Hohass Ekwesh victim)|youngest]] member of the group to engage the Wraiths as a training exercise.<ref name="MK" />

The warrior charged Ekwesh, who chose to protect his injured companion by throwing a cloud of [[Unidentified glittering dust|glittering dust]] at the youngest warrior as he attempted to attack the defenseless Sandskimmer. This opening allowed the warrior to strike Ekwesh across the midsection with his [[amphistaff]]. Before he could deliver the a finishing blow, the warrior was distracted by the explosion that [[Death/Legends|killed]] his leader, who had been struck by a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] launched by [[Voort saBinring]], another Wraith Squadron commando hiding from a distance. As the warrior turned toward the source of the explosion, he exposed his neck, allowing saBinring to fatally shoot him with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuuzhan Vong warrior  was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the  [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
